name: Savory Cream (Cold Entree)
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: A small lobster or 1 can passed through a sieve
ingredients.originalText: A small lobster or 1 can passed through a sieve
ingredients.quantityText: A small lobster or 1 can passed through a sieve

ingredients.name: 1/2 oz. or little more of gelatine
ingredients.originalText: 1/2 oz. or little more of gelatine
ingredients.quantityText: 1/2 oz. or little more of gelatine

instructions.text: Put a little aspic jelly in the bottom of a border mould, decorate with small pieces of lobster and small leaves of parsley
Beat gelatine in tomato juice, whip the cream; also whip the aspic
Stir in the mayonnaise and the melted gelatine and tomato, also your lobster
Fill the mould carefully and set
When cold turn out and fill the centre with small salad

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put a little aspic jelly in the bottom of a border mould, decorate with small pieces of lobster and small leaves of parsley
2. Beat gelatine in tomato juice, whip the cream; also whip the aspic
3. Mix these together
4. Stir in the mayonnaise and the melted gelatine and tomato, also your lobster
5. Fill the mould carefully and set
6. When cold turn out and fill the centre with small salad
